name: industrial-agent-evaluation-lab
description: A replayable evaluation platform for tool-using maintenance agents operating against live REST services and PostgreSQL.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix services/tool-api ci && npm --prefix apps/console ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix services/tool-api run build && npm --prefix apps/console run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix services/tool-api test && npm --prefix apps/console test
